input: Build a reading nook under the stairs

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The extent of the build — whether it includes just seating, or also shelving, lighting, doors, and storage — completely changes the complexity and cost of the project.
Knowing who will use it (an adult, a child, multiple people) affects the dimensions, safety requirements, and design choices like ceiling clearance and cushion size.
The current state of the under-stair space — open, drywalled, with existing electrical — determines how much prep work is needed before building begins.
The budget determines whether this is a DIY project with basic materials or a custom carpentry build, and sets limits on fixtures, finishes, and hired labor.
The desired style (built-in, rustic, modern, cozy cave) dictates material choices, paint or stain, and whether it blends with existing home decor.
Whether the user is doing this themselves or hiring a contractor determines the type of plan needed — a step-by-step DIY guide vs. a brief for a professional.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — maximum coziness, extra storage, a showpiece feature — helps prioritise trade-offs throughout the project.

gold.taskTitle: Build a reading nook under the stairs
gold.taskDescription: Convert the space under a staircase into a functional, comfortable reading nook.

questions.title: What features do you want included beyond seating?
questions.description: Establish the full scope: seating only, or also built-in shelving, reading light, storage drawers, curtain or door, etc.

questions.title: Who is the nook primarily being built for?
questions.description: Identify the primary user — a young child, a teenager, an adult, or the whole family — to inform sizing, safety, and comfort requirements.

questions.title: What is the current state of the under-stair space?
questions.description: Determine whether the space is open framing, already drywalled, has existing electrical, or is being used for storage right now.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this project?
questions.description: Set a spending ceiling to guide material quality, fixture choices, and whether any professional labor is feasible.

questions.title: What style or aesthetic are you going for?
questions.description: Identify the desired look — cozy cave, clean modern built-in, rustic wood, painted cottage — so material and finish choices align with the home's decor.

questions.title: Are you building this yourself or hiring someone?
questions.description: Clarify whether the plan needs to be a DIY step-by-step guide or a scope brief to hand to a carpenter or contractor.

questions.title: What would make this nook feel like a total success?
questions.description: Uncover the top priority — maximum storage, ultimate coziness, impressive visual impact, child-safe enclosure — to guide trade-off decisions throughout the build.
